effect: Boosts ability stats and weapon stats. The shard most players chase first.
effects: +10% (+15%) Ability Strength
+10% (+15%) Ability Duration
+25% (+37.5%) Melee Critical Damage
+25% (+37.5%) Primary Status Chance
+25% (+37.5%) Secondary Status Chance
farm: Weekly Archon Hunt vs Archon Amar (Veilbreaker required). Also: Netracells / Deep Archimedea, weekly Bird 3 rotation (Sanctum Anatomica), 1999 Calendar.
name: Crimson Archon Shard
tags: crimson red ability strength duration melee crit status primary secondary tauforged amar nuke
tips: Ability Strength is the most universally useful bonus in the game — stack it on nuke frames and ability-DPS builds.
Ability Duration is premium on frames like Nova, Vauban and Protea whose key abilities scale with it.
Melee Critical Damage is the go-to for weapons-platform frames like Khora and Baruuk.

effect: Boosts utility stats: casting speed, parkour velocity and orb effectiveness.
effects: +25% (+37.5%) Casting Speed
+45% (+67.5%) Energy Orb Effectiveness
+30% (+45%) Parkour Velocity
+100% (+150%) Health Orb Effectiveness
Start each mission with +50 (+75) Energy
farm: Weekly Archon Hunt vs Archon Nira (Veilbreaker required). Also: Netracells / Deep Archimedea, weekly Bird 3 rotation (Sanctum Anatomica), 1999 Calendar.
name: Amber Archon Shard
tags: amber orange yellow casting speed parkour velocity energy orb health orb spawn energy tauforged nira
tips: Casting Speed is a hidden DPS multiplier for slow-casting nukes — one of the most underrated shard bonuses.
Parkour Velocity makes any frame feel faster on open maps; it stacks with bullet-jump mods.
Energy Orb Effectiveness pairs with Equilibrium for near-infinite sustain.

effect: Flat survivability stats applied after all other bonuses — tanks and low-energy casters love it.
effects: +150 (+225) Max Health
+150 (+225) Max Shield Capacity
+50 (+75) Max Energy
+5 (+7.5) Health/s Regeneration
farm: Weekly Archon Hunt vs Archon Boreal (Veilbreaker required). Also: Netracells / Deep Archimedea, weekly Bird 3 rotation (Sanctum Anatomica), 1999 Calendar.
name: Azure Archon Shard
tags: azure blue max energy health shields armor regen survivability tank tauforged boreal
tips: Flat Armor and Health apply after mods, so they scale well on already-tanky frames like Inaros and Nidus.
Max Energy is the fix for energy-hungry casters running Blind Rage — combine with Amber casting speed.
Health regen is weak on its own; only take it if nothing else on Azure fits your build.

effect: Electricity-themed shard: ability damage vs shocked enemies, primary electricity damage and melee crit.
effects: +10% (+15%) Ability Damage on enemies affected by Electricity Status
+30% (+45%) Primary Electricity Damage, plus +10% (+15%) per Crimson, Azure or Violet shard equipped
+25% (+37%) Melee Critical Damage — doubles when Max Energy is over 500
Health pickups grant +20% (+30%) Energy; Energy pickups grant +20% (+30%) Health
farm: Coalescent Fusion: fuse 1 Crimson + 1 Azure shard (50 Stela, Helminth Coalescent Segment). Tauforged Violet requires fusing two Tauforged primaries. Also possible from the 1999 Calendar.
name: Violet Archon Shard
tags: violet purple electricity melee crit ability damage energy health conversion coalescent fusion gyre
tips: The melee crit bonus is huge on high-energy melee frames — 500+ energy doubles it to +50% (+74% Tauforged).
Pairs naturally with electricity-status weapons and Gyre's kit.
Do NOT expect old primary/secondary crit bonuses — Violet is electricity-focused since Whispers in the Walls.

effect: Blast, Heat and Radiation shard — sustain and secondary crit scaling.
effects: Recover 1 (2) Health per enemy killed with Blast Damage. Max 300 (450)
Regenerate +5 (+7.5) Shields when you inflict an enemy with Blast Status
+1% (+1.5%) Secondary Critical Chance per kill of a Heat-affected enemy. Max 50% (75%)
+10% (+15%) Ability Damage on enemies affected by Radiation Status
farm: Coalescent Fusion: fuse 1 Crimson + 1 Amber shard (50 Stela, Helminth Coalescent Segment). Tauforged Topaz requires fusing two Tauforged primaries. Also possible from the 1999 Calendar.
name: Topaz Archon Shard
tags: topaz blast heat radiation shields secondary crit coalescent fusion mesa
tips: The secondary crit bonus turns Heat-status secondaries into crit monsters — up to +75% crit on Tauforged.
Shield regen on Blast status is strong on frames that spam Blast, like Mesa's Peacemakers.
Blast-health sustain is niche but great on frames already modding Blast.

effect: Toxin and Corrosive shard — built for Saryn and armor-strip builds.
effects: Toxin Status Effects deal +30% (+45%) more damage
Recover +2 (+3) Health each time enemies are damaged by a Toxin Status Effect
+10% (+15%) Ability Damage on enemies affected by Corrosion Status
Increase max stacks of Corrosion Status by +2 (+3)
farm: Coalescent Fusion: fuse 1 Amber + 1 Azure shard (50 Stela, Helminth Coalescent Segment). Tauforged Emerald requires fusing two Tauforged primaries. Also possible from the 1999 Calendar.
name: Emerald Archon Shard
tags: emerald green toxin corrosive corrosion saryn armor strip coalescent fusion
tips: A natural fit for Saryn — more Toxin status damage and sustain from Spores/Toxic Lash ticks.
Extra Corrosion stacks speed up armor strip on high-level Grineer and Corrupted.
Ability damage vs corroded enemies stacks multiplicatively with the Corrosion armor strip itself.

effect: Rarer variants with 1.5x the stat bonus of a normal shard. Same slot, same bonus pick — just stronger.
effects: 1.5x effect strength (e.g. +10% → +15% Ability Strength)
[STRING_PLACEHOLDER_1]
Archon Hunt drop: 20% base chance, +20% each miss (pity) up to 100%, resets on drop — tracked per color
Netracells / Deep Archimedea can roll Tauforged as rare loot
farm: Archon Hunts (20% base, pity to 100%), Netracells and Deep Archimedea rare rolls. Ascent Fusion: fuse 3 same-color normal shards + 100 Stela for a guaranteed Tauforged.
name: Tauforged Archon Shards
tags: tauforged 1.5x stronger rare pity ascent fusion upgrade
tips: Ascent Fusion is the reliable path — 3 spare normal shards of one color guarantee a Tauforged.
Tauforged Crimson (strength) and Amber (casting speed) are the most impactful upgrades.
Fuse Tauforged primaries together to make Tauforged Violet/Topaz/Emerald.

effect: The main weekly source: one shard per hunt, rotating color.
effects: Crimson shard — hunt Archon Amar
Amber shard — hunt Archon Nira
Azure shard — hunt Archon Boreal
Requires the Veilbreaker quest (Archon Hunt node unlocks after) and a decently built frame
Tauforged chance: 20% base, +20% pity per missed Tauforged of that color, resets on drop
farm: Weekly reset — Archon Hunt node in the Star Chart. Each completion guarantees 1 shard of the week's color.
name: Archon Hunts — Weekly Shards
tags: archon hunt weekly amar nira boreal veilbreaker tauforged pity farm
tips: Always do the weekly hunt even if the color isn't your priority — shards are fusion fuel for Violet/Topaz/Emerald.
Pity is tracked per color, so a dry spell on Tauforged eventually guarantees one.
Archon Hunts are Steel Path-tier difficulty; bring a real build.

effect: Endless shard farming from Albrecht's Laboratories — the fastest way to stockpile.
effects: Crimson, Amber and Azure shards drop as common rewards (~52.5%)
Tauforged variants can roll as rare loot (~12.5%)
Deep Archimedea reward pools (Uncommon/Rare/Legendary) also include shards, up to 50% Tauforged on Legendary
5 Netracell runs per week per player
farm: Sanctum Anatomica on Deimos (Whispers in the Walls required). Netracells: 5 weekly runs. Deep Archimedea: weekly Elite mode.
name: Netracells & Deep Archimedea
tags: netracell deep archimedea deimos sanctum anatomica albrecht farm tauforged
tips: Netracells are the best shard-per-hour source in the game — run all 5 weekly.
Deep Archimedea Legendary pool is the only place with a 50% Tauforged roll.
Netracells are level 200+ — bring your strongest loadout.

effect: Buy one rotating Crimson/Amber/Azure shard per week with Cavia standing.
effects: One shard per week, color rotates
Costs 30,000 Cavia standing
Requires Rank 5 (Illuminate) with the Cavia syndicate
Find it under Shiny Treasures at Bird 3 in Sanctum Anatomica
farm: Sanctum Anatomica, Deimos — Bird 3 vendor, Shiny Treasures tab. Weekly reset.
name: Bird 3 — Weekly Shard Purchase
tags: bird 3 cavia sanctum anatomica standing weekly purchase chipper kahl
tips: Cheapest guaranteed shard each week once you're max rank with Cavia.
Note: Chipper in Kahl's Garrison no longer sells shards — they were moved to Bird 3.

effect: What you need before slotting any shard: the Helminth Archon Shard Segment.
effects: Blueprint awarded for completing the Veilbreaker quest
Build cost: 50,000 credits, 2 Entrati Lanthorn, 10 Devolved Namalon, 5 Sporulate Sac, 50 Thrax Plasm, 24h build time
Each Warframe has 5 shard slots; each shard gives one bonus pick
Bonuses stack — you can socket the same bonus multiple times
Shards can be unsocketed for 30% Helminth Bile; selling or subsuming a sharded frame LOSES the shards
farm: Complete the Veilbreaker quest, then build the segment in the Foundry and install it in the Helminth room.
name: Helminth Shard Segment
tags: helminth segment veilbreaker install socket remove bile slot
tips: Selling or subsuming a Warframe with shards slotted destroys them — unsocket first.
Plan your 5 slots per frame before slotting; removal costs Bile each time.
The Arsenal shows which frames have shards via the shard filter.

effect: Combine two primary shards to create Violet, Topaz or Emerald.
effects: Crimson + Azure = Violet Archon Shard
Crimson + Amber = Topaz Archon Shard
Amber + Azure = Emerald Archon Shard
Costs 50 Stela per fusion (from Albrecht's Laboratories missions)
Normal shards only fuse with normal; Tauforged only with Tauforged
Fusion is PERMANENT — you must type CONFIRM
farm: Requires the Helminth Coalescent Segment: blueprint from Bird 3 for 30,000 standing at Cavia Rank 2 (Researcher), then 24h build.
name: Coalescent Fusion
tags: coalescent fusion violet topaz emerald stela segment combine permanent
tips: Don't fuse shards you might want slotted — Violet/Topaz/Emerald can't be split back.
Fuse Tauforged pairs for Tauforged secondary shards.
Farm extra primaries from Netracells so fusions don't eat your slotted shards.

effect: Combine 3 shards of the same color into a guaranteed Tauforged.
effects: 3x Crimson → 1x Tauforged Crimson (works for all 6 colors)
Costs 100 Stela per fusion
Requires the Helminth Coalescent Segment installed
Fusion is PERMANENT — type CONFIRM to complete
farm: Same unlock as Coalescent Fusion: Bird 3 blueprint, 30k standing, Cavia Rank 2.
name: Ascent Fusion
tags: ascent fusion tauforged 3 shards stela guaranteed upgrade
tips: The pity-free path to Tauforged: 3 spare normals = 1 guaranteed Tauforged.
Best used on colors you have in surplus (Azure tends to pile up).
Remember Tauforged = 1.5x bonus — always worth it for your main frames.

effect: Maximum ability damage output — stack Ability Strength.
effects: 3–5x Crimson: Ability Strength (+10% each, +15% Tauforged)
Optional: 1x Amber Casting Speed so slow nukes fire faster
Optional: 1x Azure Max Energy for energy-hungry nukes
farm: Crimson from Archon Amar hunts and Netracells; Tauforged via pity or Ascent Fusion.
name: Setup: Nuke Frames
tags: nuke strength setup archetype saryn mesa volt damage build
tips: Best on: Saryn, Mesa, Equinox, Volt, Gyre, Ember.
Strength has diminishing returns past a point — past ~300% total, consider duration or casting speed instead.

effect: Maximum effective HP — stack flat Armor and Health.
effects: 2–3x Azure: Armor (+150 each, +225 Tauforged)
1–2x Azure: Max Health (+150 each, +225 Tauforged)
Optional: 1x Crimson Ability Duration for defensive abilities (e.g. Mesmer Skin, Warding Halo)
farm: Azure from Archon Boreal hunts and Netracells; Bird 3 weekly rotation.
name: Setup: Tank Frames
tags: tank armor health setup archetype inaros nidus rhino survivability build
tips: Best on: Inaros, Nidus, Rhino, Grendel, Kullervo.
Flat values apply after mods, so they punch above their weight on already-tanky frames.
Skip Shield Capacity on Kullervo — he has no shields to benefit.

effect: Buff the guns and blades, not the abilities.
effects: Crimson: Melee Critical Damage (+25%, +37.5% Tauforged)
Crimson: Primary/Secondary Status Chance (+25%, +37.5% Tauforged)
Violet: Melee Critical Damage (+25%, doubles to +50% over 500 max energy)
Topaz: Secondary Critical Chance scaling (+1% per Heat kill, up to 50%/75%)
farm: Crimson from Amar hunts; Violet/Topaz via Coalescent Fusion of Crimson pairs.
name: Setup: Weapons Platforms
tags: weapons platform melee crit status chance khora mesa excalibur gun build
tips: Best on: Khora, Baruuk, Mesa (Peacemakers), Excalibur.
Violet melee crit + high max energy (Azure energy shard) is a nasty combo — the bonus doubles.

effect: Fix small energy pools and slow casts on ability-spam frames.
effects: 2x Azure: Max Energy (+50 each, +75 Tauforged)
1–2x Amber: Casting Speed (+25% each, +37.5% Tauforged)
Optional: Amber Energy Orb Effectiveness for orb sustain
farm: Azure from Boreal hunts; Amber from Nira hunts.
name: Setup: Energy-Hungry Casters
tags: energy hungry caster max energy casting speed blind rage gyre build
tips: Best on: frames running Blind Rage, Gyre, Protea, Wisp with heavy ability use.
+150 max energy from two Tauforged Azures is often enough to drop Flow.
Casting speed also reduces animation lock — a hidden survivability gain.

effect: Maximum movement — stack parkour velocity and cast speed.
effects: 2–3x Amber: Parkour Velocity (+30% each, +45% Tauforged)
1x Amber: Casting Speed for buff-casting on the move
Optional: 1x Crimson Ability Duration for speed buffs (Volt, Wisp)
farm: Amber from Archon Nira hunts and Netracells.
name: Setup: Speed / Parkour Frames
tags: speed parkour velocity volt wukong titania movement build
tips: Best on: Volt, Wukong, Titania, Gauss, any open-world runner.
Parkour velocity stacks with bullet-jump mods and Arcane Consequence.
Three Ambers has diminishing feel — two is the sweet spot for most frames.

effect: Faster, harder-hitting Molecular Prime without touching her build.
effects: 2x Crimson: Ability Strength (+20%, +30% Tauforged) — bigger Molecular Prime explosions
1x Amber: Casting Speed (+25%) — Molecular Prime casts noticeably faster
Remaining 2 slots: flex — Azure Max Energy or Crimson Duration for Slow Nova
farm: Crimson via Archon Amar; Amber via Archon Nira.
name: Nova Prime — Shard Setup
tags: nova prime example setup strength casting speed molecular prime
tips: Slow Nova wants Duration instead of the second Strength shard — match shards to your Nova variant.
Casting speed is Nova's best QoL shard; Molecular Prime's long cast gets interrupted often.
Tauforged Crimson strength pairs perfectly with her already-high base strength.

effect: Toxin status damage and sustain built for her kit.
effects: 2x Emerald: Toxin Status Damage (+30% each) and Corrosion stack cap
2x Crimson: Ability Strength for Spores/Toxic Lash scaling
1x Amber: Casting Speed or Energy Orb Effectiveness
farm: Emerald via Coalescent Fusion (Amber + Azure); Crimson via Amar hunts.
name: Saryn — Shard Setup
tags: saryn example setup emerald toxin corrosive spores
tips: Emerald's Toxin status damage buff applies to Spores ticks — her main damage source.
Extra Corrosion stacks melt high-level armor alongside her armor-strip builds.
This is one of the few frames where Emerald clearly beats more Crimson.

effect: Longer Mesmer Skin and harder-hitting Reave/Danse Macabre.
effects: 2x Crimson: Ability Duration (+20%, +30% Tauforged) — longer Mesmer Skin charges and Enthrall
2x Crimson: Ability Strength — bigger Danse Macabre and Reave damage
1x Azure: Armor or Max Health for buffer between Mesmer Skin refreshes
farm: Crimson via Archon Amar; Azure via Boreal hunts.
name: Revenant — Shard Setup
tags: revenant example setup duration mesmer skin strength
tips: Duration is Revenant's most valuable stat — Mesmer Skin uptime is everything.
Strength scales Reave's %health damage and Danse Macabre beams.
One Azure armor shard noticeably thickens his safety net.

effect: The unkillable sand king, even more unkillable.
effects: 3x Azure: Armor (+450, +675 Tauforged)
1x Azure: Max Health (+150, +225 Tauforged)
1x Crimson: Ability Strength for Scarab Swarm armor bonus
farm: Azure via Archon Boreal hunts and Netracells (Azure tends to pile up — perfect Ascent Fusion fodder).
name: Inaros — Shard Setup
tags: inaros example setup armor health tank
tips: Inaros has no shields — never take Azure Shield Capacity on him.
Armor shards scale with Scarab Swarm's armor bonus multiplicatively in feel.
Tauforged Azure armor is one of the single strongest defensive upgrades in the game.

effect: Harder Peacemakers with shield sustain from Blast.
effects: 2x Crimson: Ability Strength for Peacemaker damage
1x Topaz: Shield regen on Blast status + secondary crit scaling for Regulators
1x Amber: Casting Speed for faster Shatter Shield/Shooting Gallery refreshes
1x Azure: Max Energy for Peacemaker drain
farm: Crimson via Amar hunts; Topaz via Coalescent Fusion (Crimson + Amber).
name: Mesa — Shard Setup
tags: mesa example setup peacemakers topaz strength regulators
tips: Topaz's shield regen triggers constantly while Peacemakers apply Blast — near-free shield gating.
Secondary crit from Topaz applies to her Regulators on Heat-status kills.
Tauforged Crimson strength is Mesa's single biggest damage shard.

effect: Which shards to chase first when you're starting the system.
effects: Priority 1: Crimson Ability Strength — useful on literally every frame
Priority 2: Amber Casting Speed — one per caster frame
Priority 3: Azure Max Energy or Armor — depends on your main frame
Don't fuse early: bank 5+ of each primary color before spending any on Coalescent Fusion
Always run the weekly Archon Hunt and all 5 Netracells — shards are forever
farm: Weekly Archon Hunts + Netracells from day one of Veilbreaker/Whispers in the Walls.
name: New Player Shard Priority
tags: new player priority guide beginner which shard first
tips: One Tauforged Crimson strength shard is the single best early-game power spike from this system.
Save Tauforged shards for your most-played frames — they're rare.
Topaz/Violet/Emerald are luxury picks; primaries first.
